newsitem.title: USA: Diana sees no immediate liquidity crisis.
newsitem.headline: Diana sees no immediate liquidity crisis.

text.p: Diana Corp said Thursday it sees no immediate liquidity crisis and will continue to work with customers to collect its roughly $8.3 million in accounts receivable.

Diana said it made the statement in response to a Dow Jones & Co Inc story on the company's financial position. The story took figures in Diana's Form 10Q out of context and did not contact the company for a comment, Diana said.
Diana said its accounts receivable include about $6 million from a single major customer. It said the customer will pay $1.7 million to Diana this month.
Diana said the customer's line of credit associated with the payment has been pre-approved by the customer's creditors, and Diana expects to accept the remaining balance in a "timely manner."
